subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should `ChannelPlugin.reload.accountScopedRestart` become a supported additive plugin contract, with Mattermost as the first and only current opt-in?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but accepting a reusable plugin capability and its permanent isolation obligations is an API/product ownership decision that automated review cannot make.

options.title: Approve the opt-in contract
options.body: Accept the documented optional capability, keep Mattermost as the sole opt-in, refresh onto current main, and land after exact-head gates remain green.

options.title: Keep policy gateway-internal
options.body: Reject the reusable plugin field and redesign the capability as an internal registry decision, trading extensibility for tighter core ownership.

options.title: Defer targeted reloads
options.body: Retain wholesale restarts until maintainers are ready to own a stable account-isolation contract across plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented optional capability, keep Mattermost as the sole opt-in, refresh onto current main, and land after exact-head gates remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to the existing gateway suppression lifecycle whose contract is being extended.
